name: haber-sametbasbug-dev
description: Editorial-first AI-assisted news publishing system for haber.sametbasbug.dev

scripts.dev:ssr: npm run build:ssr && npm run dev:db && wrangler dev --config wrangler.ssr.jsonc
scripts.dev:db: wrangler d1 migrations apply haber --local --config wrangler.ssr.jsonc
scripts.build:ssr: npm run gorsel:kucuk && astro build --config astro.config.ssr.mjs
scripts.typecheck: astro sync && npm run types:gen && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:orbit: node worker/tools/orbit-token-tests.mjs && node worker/tools/orbit-giris-tests.mjs && node worker/tools/identity-tests.mjs && node worker/tools/orbit-eylem-tests.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run test:newsroom && npm run test:orbit && npm run typecheck && npm run build
